description: Information about data processing is not provided in a concise, transparent, intelligible, and easily accessible form using clear and plain language, particularly when addressing children.
applicability: Applicable to all communications with data subjects about processing activities. Includes privacy notices, consent forms, and responses to data subject requests.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of privacy communications for clarity, accessibility, and language. Assess readability level and presentation format.

sources.title: GDPR - Regulation (EU) 2016/679
sources.section: Chapter III - Rights of the Data Subject
